description: This file contains common utility functions, test case structures, and test data for number conversion tests within the Abseil C++ library, specifically for testing integer to string conversions and string to integer parsing.

methods.name: Itoa
methods.description: Converts an integer value to its string representation in a specified base.

methods.name: strtouint32_test_cases
methods.description: Provides a set of test cases for parsing 32-bit unsigned integers from strings.

methods.name: strtouint64_test_cases
methods.description: Provides a set of test cases for parsing 64-bit unsigned integers from strings.
